services.name: Rental Instructions
services.desc: Clean up of the area is your responsibility. Please ensure pool members or the next rental group does not have a mess. When you reserve a space, you are committing to occupy prime real estate at the pool. The pool board members and staff make behind-the-scenes efforts to accommodate the reservation, not to mention you are denying other members the opportunity to rent the space. Please do not reserve “just in case” you want to use it. Reservations must be made at least 7 days before the event to allow the pool time to make any necessary staffing requirements. There are NO same-day reservations. Please contact membership with any questions about this. Please do not book reservations directly

services.name: Pickleball
services.desc: Old Farm Pool has FOUR lighted courts for you to play Pickleball (two Pickleball only and two Paddle Tennis courts that can be used for Pickleball). At this time, the courts are available on a non-reserved, first come - first served basis. The two dedicated Pickleball courts are available daily from 5:30 AM - 11:00 PM. The Paddle Tennis courts may be used for Pickleball if they are not being used by Paddle Tennis players (Paddle Tennis players have priority on these two courts). During the year, there are Pickleball tournaments, league play, and clinics. These events will be announced and will have priority over open play. services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Group lessons for our youngest member swimmers are handled as part of our Little Eagles and Pre-Team swim team programs. These are group level lessons, with the addition of being able to participate in swim team social events. There is no requirement to attend swim meets - although there are special events just for the young swimmers at meets, and an optional meet at the end of the summer. Morning or afternoon sessions are available. Registration for these programs is through the swim team. The swimmers will undergo an evaluation and be assigned to a group based on their current skills (shallow water or deep water lessons). As they progress, they can be moved up in a group.
